environment.working_tree: Modified worktree (50 paths): Products planning/evidence, Catalog adapter/tests and local migrations; no Supabase remote writes or migration applications.

input_artifacts: User decision: ERP transversal para pymes de distintos sectores desde el inicio.
User-confirmed Products item classes, independent operational uses, category hierarchy, product-level sourcing and variant SKU rules.

decisions.summary: Define a cross-sector SME ERP capability map and boundaries before client-specific implementation; prioritize MiauCraft and then Inhand.
Inhand's initial direction is physical products, a LoopDev-owned commerce backend, one warehouse and an external payment provider.
ERP target customers are SMEs across sectors; this does not approve a full ERP or the first-release module set.

Products has one master for finished products, raw materials/components and services; item class is independent from purchasing, selling and inventory tracking; the product base has a general category and each separately managed/sold SKU has its own category; drafts may omit category but activation requires it; finished products allow buy/make/both sourcing, raw materials/components are buy-only for now, services have no sourcing, and variants inherit product sourcing; semimanufactured items await Manufacturing discovery.
The product base has a general category and each variant/SKU has an independently assigned category; only sourcing is inherited from the product.
The first validated release's module set and sequence remain open.
Catalog documentation, remote adapter and migration evidence conflict; deployment/runtime behavior is unverified.
Local catalog permission naming differs from the remote migration; canonical action IDs need resolution.

actions: Recorded the user's confirmed cross-sector SME target without treating it as approval for an unbounded ERP MVP.
Expanded the discovery map and ledger with sector-neutral candidate areas for sales, procurement, inventory, finance and operational reporting.
Preserved existing capability IDs and documented the first-release module set as open.
Revalidated the current discovery against the V2 source-of-truth, platform UI/shell references, product definition, approved plan and current implementation.

Confirmed the canonical desktop route and recorded its runtime failure when VITE_CATALOG_ADAPTER_MODE is unset; local_demo is forbidden for the authenticated tenant because the fixture data is scoped to local-development-organization.

Confirmed ADAPTER-MODE-001 makes mode selection explicit and strict Catalog persistence errors visible; its focused tests pass, while authenticated remote runtime remains unverified and no remote writes were attempted.

Amended discovery with CR-ERP-PRODUCT-MASTER-MODEL after the user's product-model decisions; the category-inheritance assumption was subsequently resolved by the user in favor of independently assigned SKU categories.
